use_OpCode_class: use the OpCode class to access Python bytecode opcodes as named class attributes
check_hasjmp_set: check if an opcode is a jump instruction using the hasjmp set of all jump opcodes
check_hascondjmp_set: check if an opcode is a conditional jump using the hascondjmp set
wrap_function_with_opcode_key_wrapper: wrap a function with opcode_key_wrapper to convert KeyError into descriptive ValueError for invalid opcodes
disassemble_with_dis_extension: disassemble Python bytecode using the dis module extended with OpCode and jump opcode sets
